metadata.evidence_scope: Frozen connectome-model prediction of DNg02 firing; no biological or flight validation
limitations: Graph-selected upstream inputs are hypotheses; seven lack a verified cell-type label and none are assumed to be visual sensory inputs.
DNg02 has published flight-amplitude evidence, but this frozen assay predicts neural firing only, not takeoff or flight.
FAFB brain omits complete ventral nerve cord and wing-muscle system.
Shiu LIF model was biologically validated for feeding/grooming; these DNg02 outputs have no new independent biological validation.
Only200ms and3 simulation seeds; no general biological efficacy conclusion.
DNg02 subtypes a..g are pooled; signed-connectivity weights reflect author predictions.
Zero spontaneous activity means sham0 is expected and tests only this driven state.
Existing author model has a reset compatibility correction (remove undeclared w assignment).
Open-loop brain signal; no sensor feedback.
compatibility_adjustments: Removed undeclared upstream reset assignment w=0; source untouched
data_loading_adjustments: Projected three required connectivity columns; retained every edge and cell
metadata.hypothesis: The eight upstream targets, selected by positive graph weight before observing activity, increase pooled DNg02 firing relative to sham; removing all outgoing target weights reduces the DNg02 mean rate by at least 80%. This is a model-generated hypothesis, not an established biological finding.
metadata.question: Do eight connectivity-selected right-side upstream neurons drive firing in flight-related DNg02 cells in the fixed full-v783 LIF model, and does this response require their outgoing connections?

graph.layout: abstract schematic; no anatomical coordinates or inferred synapses
graph.selection: all stimulated and readout IDs, 96 most active recorded cells, up to 256 uniformly sampled v783 model IDs

sources.title: Namiki et al. (2022) · DNg02 flight evidence
sources.scope: Population activation relates to wingbeat amplitude in already flying, tethered flies. It does not show virtual takeoff or validate our rate-to-motor adapter.

sources.title: Schlegel et al. (2024) · cell-type annotation
sources.scope: 25 selected DNg02 entries are verified in the installed v783 graph. Subtypes are pooled; all selected entries are retained in the mean-rate denominator.

sources.title: Frozen DNg02 experiment design
sources.scope: Two tests, three fixed seeds, 25 predefined DNg02 readouts; hypothesis selected before observing the response.

sources.title: DNg02 target identity and biological evidence
sources.scope: Annotation release and graph-selected upstream identities. Flight-related biological evidence does not validate this model as a flying brain.
